cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only tidying up after you. One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives; I'll put everything else away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep that cup on the top shelf. Could you reach it for me? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on speaker for a moment. I'll thank him before we open the door. Could you tell me his name first?
